image_pattern_summary: Verified good images show complete prefabricated/portable cabin units — either a two-storey white/red steel-framed cabin with windows and balcony, an orange container-converted multi-storey structure, or a cream/blue portable cabin unit loaded on a transport truck. All good images show the finished, enclosed structure (not bare frames) with visible doors, windows, and cladding panels. The truck-transport image is the strongest signal of portability.

No meaningful text is printed on the product surface itself (unlike labelled equipment); brand watermarks visible in some images are incidental, not product information.
OCR would extract only company watermarks or incidental signage, not product specifications — buyers assess the structure visually.
